methodologyNotes: The roster covers 11 electric meat grinders and one stand-mixer attachment. Hamilton Beach 86650 was excluded (it is an electric pasta maker, not a meat grinder). Each priceUsd is the published US MSRP or current listed retail price verified directly from a manufacturer or major-retailer page on 2026-06-20; where no single published USD figure could be confirmed, priceUsd is null. Wattage figures reflect rated/working watts; 'max locked-rotor' marketing figures (3000W, 2800W, 1800W, 1000W) are noted in provenance, not used as motor_watts. Boolean spec fields (reverse_function, stainless_housing, includes_sausage_stuffer, circuit_breaker) are true only when a source explicitly confirms, false when a source explicitly states absence, null when no source confirms or denies. max_lb_per_min is decimal pounds/minute; lbs/hour sources are divided by 60 and rounded to two decimals. Adversarial re-verification corrected the STX Magnum housing/circuit-breaker fields, nulled the Gourmia GMG525 price and capacity (unverifiable / conflicting published prices, and the product is NOT discontinued), and set the Gourmia housing to false. accessedAt 2026-06-20.
